summary: Bushland car park in a wetlands reserve with picnic area and no homes nearby.
reasons: Mapped car park at the pin
Vehicles and boat trailers already parked

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the south and east, reserve picnic area to the north; no dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed track leads in from the west; car park has room for a van beside parked vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Reserve access only; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars and boat trailers parked in the bay; a park users' car park, not a camping area.

flags: Low-lying at about 2 m, near the Pine River
Reserve may close its gates at night; no gate mapped
sun_shade: Tree shade from the east and south; open to the north towards the lawn.

best_section.where: Sealed car park strip at the pin, south of the picnic lawn
